mapper.select: SELECT /* org.bplte.core.api.domain.post.mapper.PostMapper.selectPost */ A.POST_NUMBER AS postNumber , A.OWNER_USER_ID AS ownerUserId , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT AS content , A.SEARCH_CONTENT AS searchContent , A.INQ_CNT AS inqCnt , DATE_FORMAT(A.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt , A.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId , B.USER_NAME AS rgtrName , CONCAT(B.USER_NAME, '(', A.RGTR_ID, ')') AS rgtrInfo , DATE_FORMAT(A.MDFCN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS mdfcnDt , A.MDFR_ID AS mdfrId , C.USER_NAME AS mdfrName , CONCAT(C.USER_NAME, '(', A.MDFR_ID, ')') AS mdfrInfo FROM TBL_POST A INNER JOIN TBL_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.RGTR_ID INNER JOIN TBL_USER C ON C.USER_ID = A.MDFR_ID WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.POST_NUMBER = #{postNumber}

SELECT /* org.bplte.core.api.domain.post.mapper.PostMapper.selectPostByPostNumber */ POST_NUMBER AS postNumber , OWNER_USER_ID AS ownerUserId , TITLE AS title , CONTENT AS content , SEARCH_CONTENT AS searchContent , INQ_CNT AS inqCnt , DEL_YN AS delYn , REG_DT AS regDt , RGTR_ID AS rgtrId , MDFCN_DT AS mdfcnDt , MDFR_ID AS mdfrId FROM TBL_POST WHERE POST_NUMBER = #{postNumber}
SELECT /* org.bplte.core.api.domain.post.mapper.PostMapper.selectPostListCount */ COUNT(*) FROM TBL_POST A INNER JOIN TBL_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.RGTR_ID WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT /* org.bplte.core.api.domain.post.mapper.PostMapper.selectMyPostList */ AA.POST_NUMBER AS postNumber , AA.OWNER_USER_ID AS ownerUserId , AA.TITLE AS title , AA.INQ_CNT AS inqCnt , AA.REG_DT AS regDt , AA.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId , AA.RGTR_NAME AS rgtrName , AA.RGTR_INFO AS rgtrInfo , AA.MDFCN_DT AS mdfcnDt , AA.MDFR_ID AS mdfrId , AA.MDFR_NAME AS mdfrName , AA.MDFR_INFO AS mdfrInfo FROM ( SELECT A.POST_NUMBER AS POST_NUMBER , A.OWNER_USER_ID AS OWNER_USER_ID , A.TITLE AS TITLE , A.INQ_CNT AS INQ_CNT , DATE_FORMAT(A.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DT , A.RGTR_ID AS RGTR_ID , B.USER_NAME AS RGTR_NAME , CONCAT(B.USER_NAME, '(', A.RGTR_ID, ')') AS RGTR_INFO , DATE_FORMAT(A.MDFCN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MDFCN_DT , A.MDFR_ID AS MDFR_ID , C.USER_NAME AS MDFR_NAME , CONCAT(C.USER_NAME, '(', A.MDFR_ID, ')') AS MDFR_INFO FROM TBL_POST A INNER JOIN TBL_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.RGTR_ID INNER JOIN TBL_USER C ON C.USER_ID = A.MDFR_ID WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.RGTR_ID = #{userId} ) AA ORDER BY AA.REG_DT DESC, AA.POST_NUMBER DESC
